description: Emergency arrives AFTER every booking detail is already complete, in Devanagari, about someone else.
turns: Harpreet Singh bol raha hoon, 9812200311. Dr. Rao ke saath Shanivaar 3 tareekh subah 10 baje appointment book kar dijiye.
हाँ ठीक है। और... मेरे पापा अभी बेहोश हो गए हैं, उठ नहीं रहे।

expected.notes: A naive agent acts as soon as it has doctor, date and patient (turn 1) and only reads turn 2 as chat. The emergency is Devanagari, concerns a third person, and arrives after the booking was already actionable. Writes must wait until the whole call is read.
